description_en: Unregisters all sessions in a pay-as-you-go delivery group that has a scheduled auto scaling policy enabled
description_zh: 注销已开启定时扩缩容策略的按量付费交付组下所有会话
name: LogOffAllSessionsInAppInstanceGroup

parameters.help_en:
The delivery group ID.

Note:
The delivery group must meet the following status requirements:
ChargeType=PostPaid
NodePool.StrategyType=NODE_SCALING_BY_SCHEDULE
Status=PUBLISHED
The current time is not within the NodePool.RecurrenceSchedules window.
You can call the ListAppInstanceGroup or GetAppInstanceGroup operation to query the current status of the delivery group.
You can call the CreateAppInstanceGroup operation to create a delivery group that meets the requirements
parameters.help_zh:
交付组ID。

注意：
交付组必须满足如下状态：

NodePool.StrategyType=NODE_SCALING_BY_SCHEDULE

当前时刻不在NodePool.RecurrenceSchedules 窗口内
可通过ListAppInstanceGroup API或 GetAppInstanceGroup API查询交付组的当前状态。
可通过CreateAppInstanceGroup API 创建满足条件的交付组
